content.value:
RunCommand runs every tick and never finishes on its own.

It's ideal for TeleOp driving — the command runs continuously, reading the gamepad each tick and updating motor power.

It only ends when another command interrupts it.

Declare four private DcMotor fields: frontLeft, frontRight, backLeft, backRight.

In initialize(), get all four from hardwareMap.

steps.title: Create a RunCommand for mecanum drive

content.value:
Create a RunCommand with a lambda.

Inside, read gamepad1 sticks and compute the mecanum drive formula you learned in the gamepad input lesson: forward = -left_stick_y, strafe = left_stick_x, turn = right_stick_x. Apply it to all four motors.

Use schedule() to run it.

Start the OpMode and use the virtual gamepad. Left stick controls forward/back and strafe. Right stick controls turn. RunCommand drives forever — it runs every tick until the OpMode stops.

Next you'll learn how to bind buttons to trigger commands.
